arguments.note: Held for the intelligence oversight officer's ruling. Nothing entered in THREATBASE or WTA 28-11; nothing sent outside the section.

arguments.body: Ma'am, request a ruling today on IN-0412 before I disposition it. The analysts' open-web sweep found posts by the Tri-County Defense Force, a self-described militia of about 40 (estimate): the leader's video vows to "drive the division off this land by force" (KGRW aired it last night), and a forum post shows Gate 1. No foreign nexus in the posts or holdings; members appear to be U.S. persons. spc.pike considers it fair game as open source. The item is held; nothing is filed or sent. Where does it go: the PMO and CID, THREATBASE, or elsewhere? The WTA closes at 1500. CPT Shah is copied.
Sir, copy of my request to MAJ Calloway for a ruling on IN-0412 (militia posts naming U.S. persons, threat to the post). The item is held; nothing is filed or sent.
IN-0412 is held for MAJ Calloway's ruling; it stays out of WTA 28-11 unless she rules before 1500. Being open source does not skip the ruling.

arguments.entry: 11:34 IN-0412 (Tri-County Defense Force; open-web video and posts; vow of force; Gate 1 photos). Held for the oversight officer's ruling; request sent to io.calloway, copy sja.shah. Nothing filed or sent.
